t: Kitchen heat detector powered by a long-life sealed battery. Designed to protect kitchen-type areas. Features Advanced Thermistor heat sensing technology to detect rapid spikes in temperature rather than smoke, ideal for high fume (e.g. smoke from cooking) and high humidity (such as garage and attic) areas. Large central test / silence button. Easy to install. Fixings supplied.
b: Suitable for Kitchen, Garage or Attic
